description: Compatibility definitions for spinning project details.

details.description: Saved tool, technique and finished yarn details for older spinning projects.

tool.description: Deprecated: tool used to spin the yarn. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

fibrePreparation.description: Deprecated: form in which the fibre was prepared for spinning. Use the project description for new posts.

draftingTechniques.description: Deprecated: drafting techniques used to draw out the fibre. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

plyingTechniques.description: Deprecated: plying techniques used to combine the spun strands. Use the project description or hashtags for new posts.

plyCount.description: Deprecated: number of strands in the finished yarn. Use one for singles. Use the project description for new posts.

finishedYarn.description: Deprecated: measured yield and thickness of the finished yarn. Use the project description for new posts.

technique.description: How the fibre was drawn out while spinning.

finishedYarn.description: Optional measurements of the finished yarn.

wrapsPerInch.description: Number of wraps of the finished yarn that fit in one inch.

wheel.description: Spun on a mechanically driven spinning wheel.

combedTop.description: Combed fibre arranged into a continuous bundle.

shortDraw.description: Fibre drawn out in short increments.

longDraw.description: Fibre drawn out over a longer distance.

chainPlying.description: Plying one single by drawing it through successive loops.

andeanPlying.description: Plying the two ends of a single using an Andean plying bracelet.
